name: @heliuslabs/zolana-web-prover
description: Local Zolana Groth16 proving for browsers.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ../../scripts/build-wasm.sh && node ../../scripts/fetch-runtime.mjs && npm run generate:keys && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/prepare-prover-package.mjs
scripts.types: node ../../scripts/fetch-runtime.mjs && npm run generate:keys && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
